newline: lf, bom: no
preamble:
  shebang: #!/usr/bin/env dotnet
  directive: package Reverb.Runtime 0.1.0
  header: v1
cells:
  [0] setup
      | using Reverb;
  [1] code id=input
      | object value = 42;
      | var text = "17";
  [2] code id=match
      | var isInt = value is int number;
      | var parsed = int.TryParse(text, out var fromText);
      | if (value is not int guarded) throw new InvalidOperationException("not an int");
  [3] code id=use
      | var description = value switch
      | {
      |     int n when n > 40 => "big",
      |     int => "small",
      |     _ => "other",
      | };
      | Console.WriteLine($"{isInt} {parsed} {fromText} {guarded + 1} {description}");
diagnostics: none
